name: Hue
tagline: Vietnam's imperial capital on the Perfume River
summary: Hue was the seat of the Nguyen emperors from 1802 to 1945. Its walled Imperial City, royal tombs set in pine-covered hills and riverside pagodas make it Vietnam's richest historic city, and its food is spicy and refined.
seasonNote: February to April is best. Summer is very hot. September to December is the rainy season, with floods some years.
arrival: Phu Bai Airport is 25 minutes from the centre with flights from Hanoi and Saigon. Trains and cars from Da Nang take about 2.5 hours.
gettingAround: Walk or cycle the centre. Take a taxi, Grab or motorbike tour to the tombs.
cashTip: Vietnamese dong cash is essential at stalls, boats and markets; check note denominations carefully.
foodTip: Bún bò Huế, cơm hến and royal-style small cakes.
buyTip: Conical hats, sesame candy and Hue tea.
baseArea: South bank near Le Loi street

connections.note: Scenic coastal line over the Hai Van Pass.

items.summary: The Nguyen emperors' walled palace city, with gates, throne halls and the Forbidden Purple City.
